# Feature: AppFlow Safe Explore and Sandbox Explore

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-04 — issue 386 / PR-12 -->

## Intent

Default Safe Explore classifies interactions and blocks mutating/external/destructive network effects while allowing synthetic form input. Explicit Sandbox Explore may allow same-origin CRUD only when disposable=true.

## Preconditions

- Runtime crawl available
- SafeActionPolicy baseline present

## Happy Path

- [ ] Interactions classified: passive / local-state / form-input / mutating / external / destructive / unknown
- [ ] Safe Explore (default) intercepts mutating requests; evidence redacted
- [ ] Sandbox requires disposable=true for same-origin CRUD; external/destructive still blocked
- [ ] Form values from synthetic typed generators

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Destructive confirm buttons blocked in both modes
- [ ] GraphQL mutation bodies treated as mutating
- [ ] Third-party checkout = external/destructive

## Regression

- [ ] Frontier crawl + test sessions still work
- [ ] Dangerous label policy still blocks delete/logout/buy

## Implementation Notes

- Files: explore-policy (.ts/.mjs), runtime-crawl route intercept + synthetic forms
- Tests: explore-policy.test.ts

## Composition Gate

### Event

Crawl click/form → classify risk → allow or intercept request → redacted evidence.

### Hops

1. classifyInteractionRisk
2. exploreMode policy (safe|sandbox+disposable)
3. page.route interception in runtime-crawl
4. syntheticFormValue for inputs

## Security Coverage

- Default deny unknown mutations
- No real payments/mail/SMS
- Synthetic data only

## Typed-strict

- Touched files: zero type escape hatches
